children: Jack Henry & Associates reported fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $701.5 million, up 8.8% from a year earlier, and net income of $160.4 million. Operating income rose 12.5%, while diluted earnings per share increased to $2.28 from $1.97. The company also raised its full-year fiscal 2027 outlook, forecasting GAAP revenue of $2.698 billion to $2.718 billion.
Revenue was $701.5 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, an 8.8% increase year over year.
Operating income increased 12.5% to $207.1 million. Non-GAAP adjusted operating income rose 11.2% to $192.6 million.
Net income grew 11.4% to $160.4 million. Diluted EPS was $2.28, up from $1.97.
Non-GAAP adjusted revenue increased 7.2% to $682.2 million; non-GAAP EBITDA rose 10.2% to $248.0 million.
Fiscal 2027 guidance calls for GAAP revenue of $2.698 billion to $2.718 billion, GAAP EPS of $7.47 to $7.51, and non-GAAP adjusted revenue of $2.667 billion to $2.687 billion.
Management cited strong client demand, outstanding sales performance, and a robust pipeline.
Cloud growth reflected continued client migrations to the company’s private cloud and expanding processing volumes.
Card services benefited from monthly service and risk management fees; digital activity was supported by more active platform users and adoption of additional products.
Faster payments activity continued to expand, supported by growing transaction volumes.
The annual Connect client conference moved from the first quarter last year to the second quarter this fiscal year; the company said it will be held in the second quarter for the next four years.
